author: GamingBolt
description:
In the first part of our recap of the entire Gears of War franchise, we covered the events of Gears of War: Judgment, the first game in the series' chronology. Here in part 2, we're going to move on to Gears Tactics. 

Set a year after Emergence Day and 12 entire years before the events of the first Gears of War, Tactics is still pretty far removed from most of the story that has been told across the entirety of the franchise, but it's still a surprisingly meaty tale. Though it may be a turn-based strategy spinoff, Gears Tactics is still a story-heavy game that tells a gripping tale, one that is more crucial to the series' overarching story than you would think. So without further ado, let's dive right in.

Link to Part 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8u9azUUFL1c
title: The Complete Story of Gears Tactics - Before You Play Gears of War E-Day (Part 2)

author: GamingBolt
description:
Some critics may have dealt a few surface wounds to Marvel’s Wolverine, but Logan has managed to win over enough players to make his latest appearance a potential win for Sony and Insomniac. But what’s made the new adventure as attractive and addictive as it’s turning out to be?

You can bet we dove right in to find out, and our review of the game already hints at what we’re about to discuss here. Wolverine gets some very important aspects right, and does it so well that it manages to become the definitive way to play the character in modern gaming. 

Does it need to do more than be a darn good take on good old Logan? Join us as we get into the nuance of it all, and tell you why this one could keep you coming back to it long after you’ve rolled the credits on its story.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Why Are So MANY Gamers Addicted To It?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Just when you think Crimson Desert is quote-unquote done, and Caesar wept because there were no more features to be added, the development team returns with some notable patches. 

These arrive in the wake of update 2.0 – the Enhanced Edition with its long-awaited story fixes, Abyss Links to finally make unlocking other characters' skills easier, and much more. As such, they're nowhere near as large. Heck, several of these features may not matter for the vast majority waiting on the DLC to jump back in.
title: Crimson Desert's Recent Updates Have Been Small But Great - 10 NEW Things You Should Know
